d: US Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin has sought to reassure Americans following the nationwide air traffic outage, saying there is no current indication that it was caused by a malicious attack. Mullin repeatedly stressed that this was not another 9/11, but acknowledged that the government still has more questions than answers. Officials are working to resolve what he described as a telecommunications outage, although its cause and repair timeline remain unknown. Mullin also said he could not rule anything out.
